cases.prompt: Use compression for a small representative task within its documented purpose. Supply an offline fixture when supported.
assertions: Choose a format-specific preservation contract and keep the source until round-trip or semantic verification succeeds.
Compare decoded pixels or samples for lossless media, archive members and hashes, document text and page geometry.
cases.grader: Inspect actual output and task-specific evidence; no guessed pass.

cases.prompt: Use compression with one missing required input or unavailable dependency and a realistic boundary condition.
assertions: Report the actual missing prerequisite without claiming completion.
Preserve source files and do not fabricate missing data.

cases.prompt: Use compression with long labels, ambiguous source content, and the applicable user format constraints.
assertions: Preserve existing design and sharpness; never restyle an artifact merely to reduce bytes.
Preserve exact data, executable syntax, and source provenance.
cases.grader: Inspect rendered output when visual; inspect textual or data output otherwise.
